common_instruction: This is a response-only exercise. Use the supplied scenario and snippets; propose or review the requested work without claiming files were changed, commands ran, or external systems were inspected. State material verification limits. Equivalent solutions that satisfy the stated contract are acceptable.

cases.name: outer-slice-copy-does-not-protect-nested-storage
expectations: Identifies that cloning the outer slice copies Record values but still shares each Payload backing array.
Copies the mutable nested payloads as well as the outer records, or proposes another explicit ownership design that fulfills the existing mutation promise.
Describes a check that mutates a returned payload and confirms a later cache read is unchanged.
Preserves existing payload contents and the stated nil/empty distinction.
negative_expectations: Must not call slices.Clone or a full slice expression alone a deep copy of this structure.
Must not weaken the documented mutation promise silently or introduce synchronization as a substitute for ownership isolation.
cases.trap: Claim defensive-copy safety after copying only the outer collection.

cases.name: immutable-map-does-not-need-a-mutex
cases.prompt: A Go package builds a map[string]string completely during single-threaded startup. It then publishes the map to worker goroutines, which only read existing keys; no code writes or deletes keys, and the map values are immutable strings. A reviewer says any concurrent map access is forbidden and requests a mutex around every read or a sync.Map rewrite. Assess that recommendation under the stated lifecycle. Briefly state what changed assumption would require synchronization.
expectations: Explains that concurrent reads of a fully initialized map are safe when no writes occur and publication is properly synchronized.
Does not add a mutex or sync.Map solely for this read-only access pattern.
Identifies later mutation or unsafe publication as a reason to change the synchronization design.
negative_expectations: Must not claim all concurrent map access panics or races regardless of mutation.
Must not broaden the task into a cache-framework rewrite.
cases.trap: Apply a concurrent-map-write warning to an immutable, safely published read-only map.
